## Work Experience

### AmTrust Financial Services (2024–2025) — Desktop Specialist II
Technical support for Windows 11, Office 365, and Intune to 6,000+ users across 20 states. Managed end-to-end hardware lifecycle for company's largest office. Analyzed hardware replacement requests from Level I techs, verifying diagnosis before approval. Built documentation and knowledge-sharing resources to reduce information silos.

### Career Break (2023–2024)
Caught in a Windstream reduction in force despite consistently above-average reviews. Relocated cross-country. Started The Odin Project (Full Stack JavaScript). Explored writing, photography, and media creation.

### Windstream Communications (2019–2023) — Security Analyst I (CSOC)
Title changed upon transition from Domain Services into the Cyber Security Operations Center. Maintained CSOC warehousing LAMP website, wiki, and servers. Maintained Domain Services LAMP research website and full-stack VM environment. Consulted CSOC management on new site features, then built and deployed them. Automated daily backups to AWS. Crafted MySQL queries for actionable data per management request. Built Python script to cross-reference malicious IP lists against 13 million Windstream IPs. Developed Python scripts to bulk query hundreds of Fortinet devices. Performance rating: "Highly Successful" or "Superior" on every annual review — no exceptions.

Tech stack: ESXi, Linux, SQL, Apache, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, Python, Bash, Docker, AWS, Fortinet, Azure.

### Windstream Communications (2011–2019) — Specialist II
Promoted from Norlight Customer Support Engineer after Windstream acquisition. Go-to resource for Linux, web/DNS/email hosting, and email filtering for team of 8. Spearheaded hosting migrations for five ISP acquisitions (Norlight, Nuvox, Paetec, Earthlink, Broadview) — 5,000+ domains from 60+ servers covering 20+ products. Saved $15,000/month through domain lookup/disable project. Created scripts reducing manual processes by 70%. Managed MySQL databases for thousands of customer domains. Escalation point for 8 Specialist I team members.

### Norlight Telecommunications (2004–2011) — Customer Support Engineer
Q-Excellence award — singular recognition out of 600+ employees. Owned provisioning and operations for web, email, DNS hosting, cloud email filtering (Cleanmail), and fax-to-email system for 800+ business customers. 95%+ customer satisfaction. Completed hosting and mail-filtering platform migrations for 500+ customers and authored support documentation. Trusted with root access to entire company technology stack.

### Cinergy Communications (2001–2004) — Helpdesk Technician
ISP helpdesk supporting business and residential customers across Windows and Mac.
